contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = $647.20 on the p4 Summary Page (located by its printed heading; it is the LAST page, as the modern_boxAF tendency predicts, but it was found by content), which equals Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' $647.20 AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' $647.20
contributions.detail: The single Schedule A row is 647.20, which IS the schedule's printed page subtotal, IS its printed Total Contributions Received, and IS the cover's PROMOTED per-period cell Box B — three printed anchors agreeing to the cent on a one-row ledger. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' also prints 647.20 and is retained as the cumulative figure, NEVER summed as an increment; period and year-to-date coincide because this is a withdrawal report covering the filer's only activity. The ladder closes from the other direction too: Box A 0.00 + Box B 647.20 = Box F 647.20, and Box F - Box D = the printed 0.00 close.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = $647.20, which equals Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' $647.20 AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made (Sum of all Schedule B pages in this report)' $647.20
expenditures.detail: The single Schedule B row is 647.20 = the printed page subtotal = the printed schedule total = the cover's promoted per-period cell Box D. Box E YTD prints 647.20 and is never summed. Box F 647.20 minus Box D 647.20 = the printed 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period' 0.00, so the whole filing is one self-contribution spent entirely on one expenditure.

itemized.escalation_note: Five crops. Geometry proof at 900 dpi --value: p2 row 1 rendered a hand-drawn '$' and '647.20'; p2 row 2 (one past the only entry) rendered an EMPTY boxed cell; p3 row 1 rendered '$ 647.20'; p3 row 2 (one past) rendered an EMPTY boxed cell. LEGIBILITY escalation at 2000 dpi on the CENTS PAIR of the Schedule A amount (pct:86.0,16.5,7.5,3.0@p2): it renders '.20' unambiguously — the tens digit is this filer's looped script '2' (a clear horizontal foot) and the units digit is a narrow closed ellipse '0' with no foot, so the figure is 647.20 and NOT 647.22. ⛔ This was settled ONLY from the glyph pair on this page: the corpus's 2016/2018 Commission filing-fee figure of 647.22 was deliberately NOT used to arbitrate it (E1/F5/G6/H6 forbid using the fee to settle a figure on another filing), and the arithmetic could not arbitrate it either because every printed box on this filing carries the same single figure. Nothing was changed.

itemized.notes: Taylor Dayton, 2020 Utah County Commissioner. modern_boxAF, revision 'v. 4.20' (footer-printed), but UNLIKE the other 2020 filings on this blank it is filled in ENTIRELY BY HAND in pencil/grey ink, including a hand-drawn '$' before every figure — so the born-digital-typed assumption of ADDENDUM I3 does NOT hold filing-wide for 2020, and I1's digit-shape hazard was live (handled: see escalation_note). FOUR pages, each classified from its own printed heading: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page'. No checklist decoy. PAGE FACE: candidate 'Taylor Dayton', Office 'Utah County Commissioner C', residence city Orem, report type radio filled = '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination', amendment answered 'No' (the No radio is filled, Yes is empty), signature Date and Date of Report both 5/18/20; a sideways clerk stamp reads '20 MAY 18 PM 1:16'. THE PAGE PRINTS A COMMISSION SEAT that index.csv does not: index.csv's office is the bare 'County Commission' while the filer wrote 'Utah County Commissioner C'. Recorded here as observed; NOT promoted (this record does not touch office_overrides.csv) and no seat was inferred beyond the letter the filer actually wrote. FOLIATION: this filer numbers the Page box 1/2/3/4 counting the cover — one of the two 2020 practices in I3. REDACTION judged per cell (I4): the ONLY blacked-out region in the document is the signature bar on p1; the filer's own street address is published in the clear on p1 and again in the Schedule A address cell, and both were reduced to city/state at read time. THE WHOLE FILING IS ONE TRANSACTION: a 647.20 self-contribution on 3/19/20 and a 647.20 filing-fee payment the same day, with a 0.00 beginning and 0.00 closing balance. FILER/CHANNEL CHECK: unlike this chunk's Child filing (c848c81b, which the county's Strapi record files under Taylor Dayton), THIS document's page face genuinely names Taylor Dayton in all four Name-of-Candidate boxes, so index.csv's candidate label is correct here. The two are different documents by different filers and were transcribed wholly independently; nothing was differenced between them.
